# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** Meanwhile, Herod's search had turned to John. He sent soldiers to the temple to confront Zechariah while he was serving at the altar. "Where have you hidden your son?" they demanded. Zechariah looked them in the eye. "I serve God at this altar. I don't know where my son is."

**22:2** The soldiers came back and gave their report. Herod exploded. "That boy is going to grow up to be king of Israel." He sent the soldiers back with a harder message: "Tell him to stop lying. Where is his son? Tell him his blood is in my hands." Back they went.

**22:3** Zechariah didn't flinch. "I am a witness — a martyr — for God. Take my blood, then. But the Lord will take my spirit. And know this: the blood you spill will be innocent blood, shed on the very threshold of the Lord's temple."

**22:4** Just before dawn they killed him. The people of Israel had no idea what had happened.
